title: Local stalk equality for a finite retract sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open, and $M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_U$-modules on the slice site. Suppose there are $m\in\mathbf N$ and maps $\iota:M\to\mathcal O_U^{\oplus m}$ and $\pi:\mathcal O_U^{\oplus m}\to M$ with $\iota\pi=1_M$ (the finite-retract condition used in [def-pc-perfect-complex]). Let $Z\subseteq V\subseteq U$ be opens and $x\in Z$. Put $M_Z=(M|_V)|_Z$. If two endomorphisms $a,b:M_Z\to M_Z$ have equal maps under the open module stalk functor at $x$ [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor], there is $W\subseteq Z$ containing $x$ on which their restrictions agree. No complex or homotopy is present.

proof.text: Restrict the splitting to Z and sandwich a-b into the finite free sheaf. The finite presentation internal-Hom stalk comparison identifies zero stalk maps with zero germs of local Hom sections, or equivalently with the finitely many zero germs of the sandwich matrix entries.

Apply the scalar germ equality criterion to each matrix entry and intersect the finitely many neighbourhoods inside Z. All entries vanish there. Composing the zero sandwich map with the restricted splitting gives a=b. The empty matrix is the zero-retract case.

theorem exists_open_stalk_retract_map_eq
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
    (hM : ∃ m : ℕ,
      ∃ (ι : M ⟶ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)))
        (π : SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) ⟶ M),
        ι ≫ π = 𝟙 M)
    (x : X) (V Z : X.Opens) (hxZ : x ∈ Z) (hVU : V ≤ U) (hZV : Z ≤ V)
    (a b :
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hZV)).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hVU)).obj M) ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hZV)).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hVU)).obj M))
    (heq : (openModuleStalkFunctor X Z ⟨x, hxZ⟩).map a =
      (openModuleStalkFunctor X Z ⟨x, hxZ⟩).map b) :
    ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWZ : W ≤ Z), x ∈ W ∧
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hWZ)).map a =
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hWZ)).map b
